title: Additive equivalence for localized cohomology
statement: Under the hypotheses of cohomology over object localization, the two cohomology groups are additively equivalent.

proof.text: Construct the comparison by restricting an injective resolution to the localized site, using exactness and preservation of injectives; identify the resulting section complexes and take cohomology.

mathlib_searches.query: additive equivalence between sheaf cohomology on site and localized site
cohomology over object localized site additive equivalence

lean.statement: theorem cohomology_over_object_localization_addEquiv {C : Type u₁} [Category.{u₁} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C} [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u₁}] [HasExt.{u₁} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u₁})] (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u₁}) (W : C) (q : ℕ) [HasSheafify (J.over W) AddCommGrpCat.{u₁}] [HasExt.{u₁} (Sheaf (J.over W) AddCommGrpCat.{u₁})] : Nonempty ((Sheaf.H' F q W) ≃+ Sheaf.H' ((GrothendieckTopology.overPullback J AddCommGrpCat.{u₁} W).obj F) q (Over.mk (𝟙 W)))
